judge_verdict.reasons_for_rejection: The evaluation plan contains a critical logical error in the 'Expert Verification Plan' regarding spatial relationships. The `geometric_depth_auditor` is assigned to verify Atom 7 ('Are the suitcases to the right of the sheep?'). However, the `geometric_depth_auditor` is defined as generating relative depth maps to expose geometric melting and spatial grounding errors (Z-axis/depth), not lateral positioning (X-axis). Lateral positioning must be verified via bounding box coordinates from the `open_vocabulary_detector`. Additionally, the plan fails to assign an expert to verify the color attributes of the objects (Atoms 1, 5, 9), relying solely on the initial VLM judgment which may be prone to hallucination or lighting misinterpretation.

suggestions.reason: Replace `geometric_depth_auditor` with `open_vocabulary_detector`. The detector provides bounding boxes (x_min, x_max) which allow for precise calculation of lateral position (left/right) relative to other objects. Depth auditors cannot reliably determine left/right orientation.
